description.zh: 实例刷新任务ID，可以设置此参数查询实例刷新任务相关的伸缩活动列表。
description.en: The ID of the instance refresh task. You can set this parameter to query the list of scaling activities associated with the instance refresh task.

description.zh:
伸缩活动列表的页码，起始值：1。

默认值：1。
description.en:
The page number of the scaling activity list. Minimum value: 1.

Default value: 1.

description.zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值：50。

默认值：10。
description.en:
The number of entries per page for paging query. Maximum value: 50.

Default value: 10.

description.zh: 伸缩活动所属伸缩组的地域ID。
description.en: The region ID of the scaling group to which the scaling activities belong.

description.zh:
为待查询伸缩活动的ID。
>调用该API时，`ScalingGroupId`和`ScalingActivityId.N`参数必须二选一进行配置，如果两个参数同时都不配置，则会报错。
description.en:
The IDs of the scaling activities that you want to query.
>When you call this operation, you must specify either ScalingGroupId or ScalingActivityId.N. If you do not specify either parameter, an error is returned.

description.zh:
伸缩组的ID。
>调用该API时，`ScalingGroupId`和`ScalingActivityId.N`参数必须二选一进行配置，如果两个参数同时都不配置，则会报错。
description.en:
The ID of the scaling group.
>When you call this operation, you must specify either ScalingGroupId or ScalingActivityId.N. If you do not specify either parameter, an error is returned.

description.zh:
伸缩活动的状态。取值范围：
- Successful：执行成功的伸缩活动。 
- Warning：部分执行成功的伸缩活动。 
- Failed：执行失败的伸缩活动。
- InProgress：正在执行的伸缩活动。
- Rejected：执行伸缩活动请求被拒绝。
description.en:
The status of the scaling activity. Valid values:
- Successful: The scaling activity was executed successfully. 
- Warning: The scaling activity was partially successful. 
- Failed: The scaling activity failed.
- InProgress: The scaling activity is being executed.
- Rejected: The request to execute the scaling activity was rejected.

descriptions.zh:
## 接口说明

- 查询时可以指定伸缩组ID来查询该伸缩组下的所有伸缩活动。

- 查询时可以通过伸缩活动的状态来过滤查询结果。

- 可以查询30日内的伸缩活动。
descriptions.en:
## Operation description

- You can specify a scaling group ID to query all scaling activities in the scaling group.

- You can filter query results by the status of scaling activities.

- You can query scaling activities within the last 30 days.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ess describe-scaling-activities --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --scaling-group-id asg-bp18p2yfxow2dloq0000 --status-code Successful --scaling-activity-id asa-bp161xudmuxdzofe0000 --instance-refresh-task-id ir-a12ds234fasd00000 --api-version 2014-08-28 --region cn-hangzhou
